newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end at record high, seen bullish.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end at record high, seen bullish.

text.p: Austrian shares ended at a record high for the sixth day running on Monday, closing up 0.17 percent at 1,390.58 points and traders predicted rangebound trading short-term between 1,380 and 1,400 points.

"The friendly mood is predominant," one trader said. Others agreed that today's performance had highlighted the current strength of the market, although they noted that profit taking had set in towards the end of the session.
The bullish futures market, with the July contract substantially overvalued, pointed to further gains, dealers noted.
Of the index's constituents, 11 losers outweighed nine gainers with one stock remaining unchanged.
The top gainer was Leykam, climbing 4.18 percent to end at 334.95 schillings.
The top loser was Wolford, which dropped 2.93 percent to 1,159.95 schillings.
The July ATX future rose 7.0 points to 1,403. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
